Key Takeaways
Assessed team's production capacity and strategies to address recent sales decline.
Urgent need to increase post-Diwali production to meet daily order targets of 15,000-20,000, currently at 20-25.
Discussed marketing strategies, including a rewards points program and revitalizing old video content to boost customer engagement.
Emphasized ongoing SEO efforts, focusing on optimizing website content and conducting keyword analysis for better search visibility.
Identified the need for in-depth sales data analysis to determine order sources and evaluate product SKU performance for improvement.

Financials
Swiggy shows a run rate of 19.8 lakhs, up from 18.2 lakhs previously.
Noteworthy decline: 50% drop from 7 lakhs to 4 lakhs observed.
Monthly sales figures have increased to 42 lakhs, up from 34-35 lakhs last month.
Current run rate is 4 lakhs; target is to hit 5 lakhs this month.
Nearly 1 kilo of salaries and 50 kilos of fees daily.
Daily website orders total approximately 46 kilos.
Metrics
Tracking monthly sales figures and run rates on platforms like Swiggy and Zomato.
Discussing percentage of orders from different sources to assess performance.
Marketing Efforts
Observing stronger performance in in-store initiatives versus Google My Business and Facebook.
Considering a pivot to offline, in-store campaigns.

Increased visibility needed due to lack of recent specific actions.

Lack of response from Somnari, and no other point of contact obtained.

Focus on Diwali limited SKUs and boxes.
Plans to push campaigns and possibly credit points to stimulate orders.

Capacity
Plan to scale up production capacity after Diwali.
Current capacity: 40-50 orders per day; currently managing 20-25.
